extension.summary: 显示自定义播放器进程信息
extension.description: Öffnet ein eigenes Prozessinformationen-Fenster. Dieses enthält Codec-, Video- und Audio-Details zum aktuell abgespielten Medium.
Opens a separate process information window. This window displays codec, video, and audio details for the currently playing media.
打开一个独立的进程信息窗口。此窗口显示当前播放媒体的编解码器、视频和音频详细信息。
extension.news: v1.9.7.1 - Merged upstream v1.9.7 (major restructure: flat resources/lib/*.py moved into core/, info/, service/, ui/ packages) onto the custom base. - Re-applied to ui/fonts.py: NotoSans filename fix and update-in-place same-name Font.xml rewriting. - Re-applied to ui/overlay.py: settings-click on remote OK/Select and mouse/touch on the header chart icon, grafted alongside the new upstream arrow-key nudge feature (arrows still nudge the overlay, OK opens settings). - Re-applied to skin XML: variant-aware speaker/codec block (SDR full + extended background; HDR/HLG below metadata; DV floating top-right with dark backing plate). - NOTE: requires tools.tinyppi 1.1.4.
